highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The University of Michigan-Flint is the University of Michigan’s urban campus. If you choose this university, you’ll be located in downtown Flint on a 76-acre campus. The university offers you more than 60 undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across Health Professions, Business, Psychology, Biological Sciences, Engineering, and Computer Science.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At the University of Michigan-Flint, you can enjoy personalised attention from your professors due to small class sizes and a student‑faculty ratio of 14:1. Plus, you can choose to join any of the 100+ student clubs and organisations, sports clubs, and cultural groups.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Michigan-Flint offers you on-campus housing for the first year, in suite-style apartments at First Street Residence Hall. This housing comes with kitchens, laundry, and mandatory meal plans. Another spot is their Riverfront Residence Hall, which accommodates around 500 students and is located near academic buildings and downtown amenities.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Frances Willson Thompson Library and the Student Success Centre at the university offer you all the necessary study and resource spaces you need.

Sports
If you’re into sports, you can join the university’s sports teams for baseball, golf, soccer, hockey, and volleyball.

Laboratory
You’ll find cutting-edge labs and research facilities at the university’s College of Innovation & Technology.

Cafeteria
The University of Michigan-Flint offers many places to eat on campus. From cafes to full meals, you’ll find many choices. Some popular spots where you can get fresh food are Picasso @ UCEN, Blue Bistro, and Clint’s Cafe.
